dedupe_keys.name: database of thermal response of cold formed steel wall and floor assemblies under fire

description: Database of thermal response of cold-formed steel wall and floor assemblies under fire is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Thomas Gernay, Johns Hopkins University (jhu.edu). This project compiles test data on temperature measurements in cold-formed steel (CFS) wall and floor assemblies from fire experiments published in the literature. The data supports evaluation of the fire response of CFS assemblies and CFS structural system for performance-based structural fire analysis and design. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-2bb5-ve69. Keywords: temperature data, wall assemblies, sheathing types, fire curves, cold-formed steel, fire tests. Published 2026-09-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
